correctness.rationale: Schatten-4 membership makes all quadratic commutator terms Hilbert--Schmidt and all quartic trace products trace class. Expansion, trace cyclicity, and pairwise commutativity give the exact identity; nonnegativity then yields the rigidity consequences.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The September 2026 source poses the sum-normal normality question, while nearby prior work studies the mixed-commutator matrix mainly through determinants and trace inequalities. Searches did not locate the displayed quartic energy identity, its Schatten-4 rigidity theorem, or the finite-tracial analogue; older multivariable commutator literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact no-cancellation law, resolves the new sum-normal problem on Schatten-4 tuples, proves normality for sum-hyponormal Schatten-2 tuples, and extends naturally to finite tracial von Neumann algebras.
